key.name: auto-save-session
key.description: If enabled, cdos-session will save the session automatically.

key.name: auto-save-session-one-shot
key.description: When enabled, cdos-session will automatically save the next session at log out even if auto saving is disabled.

key.name: logout-prompt
key.description: If enabled, cdos-session will prompt the user before ending a session.

key.name: show-fallback-warning
key.description: If enabled, cdos-session will display a warning dialog after login if the session was automatically fallen back.

key.name: start-phase-timeout
key.description: The number of seconds is timeout for startup application.
